answer_1.quote: We present RLET, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) based Entailment Tree generation framework ... We evaluate our approach on EntailmentBank, a benchmark that provides expert-annotated explanations of QA pairs in the form of entailment trees.

answer_2.quote: Intermediates (BLEURT, AllCorrect) evaluate the generation quality of the intermediate conclusions. Steps (F1, AllCorrect) mainly evaluate the structure correctness of the trees. Leaves (F1, AllCorrect) evaluate how well the model performs in identifying facts.
